Data:Visitor.for.rite.renewal.json.startdescription: Is there someone en route to Hush House?

Data:Visitor.json.label: Visitor
Data:Visitor.json.desc: The primary route by which books enter and leave the library. The arrival of a visitor may be cause for a variety of emotions.

Data:Visitor.villager.json.label: Visitor: Villager
Data:Visitor.villager.json.desc: Someone from Brancrug has accepted an invitation to the House. [You can only invite one villager at a time to the House.]

Data:Visitorpatrol.json.label: Visitor Patrol
Data:Visitorpatrol.json.startdescription: Grabs embarking visitors every thirty seconds
Data:Visitorpatrol.json.comments: Now that embarking visitors should never be offstage, we can grab more widely. If that changes, the grab will need to be more selective again!

Data:W.aramaic.json.Label: Written in Aramaic
Data:W.aramaic.json.desc: The language of Aram, and all her many children these three thousand years and more. [The Librarian reads Aramaic, but don't assume others can.]

Data:W.birdsong.json.label: Birdsong
Data:W.birdsong.json.desc: Music, riddles, miscellanea. 'Less a wisdom, more a body of gossip hallowed by accretion,' a sniffy scholar once remarked.

Data:W.bosk.json.label: The Bosk
Data:W.bosk.json.desc: The Wisdom of the primaeval wood; rarely written, often felt.

Data:W.greek.json.Label: Written in Greek
Data:W.greek.json.desc: A tongue for philosophers, theologians and heroes. [The Librarian reads Greek, but don't assume others can.]

Data:W.horomachistry.json.label: Horomachistry
Data:W.horomachistry.json.desc: This Wisdom is concerned with the laws (and disagreements) of the Hours (and their emanations).

Data:W.hushery.json.label: Hushery
Data:W.hushery.json.desc: The Great Art of Hushery understands the beauty of silence, and of its sundering.

Data:W.illumination.json.label: Illumination
Data:W.illumination.json.desc: Illuminates purify the self and its surroundings. Eventually, they often cease to see any difference between the two.

Data:W.ithastry.json.label: Ithastry
Data:W.ithastry.json.desc: Alchemy, metallurgy, pyrotechnics: Ithastry is sometimes called the Art that Alters.

Data:W.latin.json.Label: Written in Latin
Data:W.latin.json.desc: A dead language: dead as diamonds. [The Librarian reads Latin, but don't assume others can.]

Data:W.nyctodromy.json.label: Nyctodromy
Data:W.nyctodromy.json.desc: 'Travelling at night is neither faster nor safer. That's why we do it.' Knowledge of the ways and byways of the transmundane.

Data:W.phrygian.json.Label: Written in Phrygian
Data:W.phrygian.json.desc: The Phrygians worshipped the Great Mother, who we call the Grail. Theirs was the land in which the Sisterhood of the Knot was born, and this is the tongue in which the Thunderskin pleaded, at his ascension. [The Librarian can read Phrygian, but few others can.]

Data:W.preservation.json.label: Preservation
Data:W.preservation.json.desc: Healing and restoration. An unglamorous Wisdom, at least to those who never wonder how the world still exists.

Data:W.sanskrit.json.Label: Written in Sanskrit
Data:W.sanskrit.json.desc: The holy tongue of the Subcontinent. The door to four thousand years of poetry, ceremony and mystery now opens before you, if you can struggle through the lotus convolutions of its vocabulary. [The Librarian reads Sanskrit, but don't assume others can.]

Data:W.skolekosophy.json.label: Skolekosophy
Data:W.skolekosophy.json.desc: The study of things that should not be studied. Some call this a Wisdom.

Data:Wallart.json.label: Wall Art
Data:Wallart.json.desc: You could describe the whole house as a book, although it would be troublesome to index.

xexts.scrutiny: An unexpectedly elegant swoop to the handle suggests something more exotic. And it's heavy. An unusual alloy… taenite? Meteoric iron? Why?

Data:Wc.callingcard.add.agdistis.json.label: Note Agdistis's Address

Data:Wc.callingcard.add.agdistis.json.desc: 'But will they come when you do call for them?'
